connector.name: Rendobar by rendobar.com
connector.registryDescription: Serverless media processing: FFmpeg jobs, timeline composition, captions, and compression.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.rendobar.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.rendobar, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: RENDOBAR_API_KEY
env.description: Rendobar API key (starts with 'rb_'). Get one at https://app.rendobar.com/settings/api-keys. The server starts without it so tools can be listed, but tool calls require it.
